scope: eight actual scanned WAV/CUE items, production native fingerprint/Windows vault/Main/preload/Service/renderer with fixture-only AcoustID and MusicBrainz transport; no live truth, user credentials, hardware or install validation
cases: actual batch cancel stops a live association lookup, preserves completed first row and leaves recording/candidate/field choices empty
actual resume processes seven remaining items, retains all eight private row associations beyond independent four limit and sends no audio/path or automatic recording read
explicit per-row recording read and candidate/title check preserve peer associations; no recording or edition identity is bound
actual library-change event clears only stale association row and preserves peer field selection and association
actual plan save stores two reviewed public ID mappings and local algorithm with only explicitly selected title fields
actual offline batch execution updates only two local titles, preserving artists/albums/identities and source WAV
actual offline compensating batch undo restores both titles and durable public provenance
trusted Main/Service prevent scope omission and forged batch transfer of a real identified audio token
actual closing owner during live Service lookup cancels its request and rejects late association publication
media-offline restart retains compensated plan and fingerprint public ID/local recipe provenance without persisting transient associations
